# requires frame

Declares that every instance of the annotated class must carry the named reference-frame property (CONSTITUTION P11, #283): 'a value asserted without its frame is ill-formed'. The frame-relativity SHACL shape is GENERATED from this declaration — exactly one frame when the named property is owl:FunctionalProperty, at least one otherwise — so a new frame-relative value class is enforced the moment it is declared, never by remembering to hand-write its shape. Pair with gmeow:frameRequirementSeverity "warning" to downgrade from violation.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/requiresFrame>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:requiresFrame`
